# cursor_organization_group_members (Resource)

Owns the member set of one manual Organization group. Routes use the group id (g_), not public_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cursor_organization_group_members" "eng" {
  group_id = cursor_organization_group.eng.id
  user_ids = ["user_example"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group id.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) Public user ids.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cursor_organization_group_members.eng g_01k2ja2000e0080000000000g1
```
